notes.title: Stability improvements
notes.content:
What's new:

[list]
[*]We worked hard on improving the stability of the mobile phone connections. This release fixes  a series of issues where the connection to the phone would become unstable. 
[*]Improved reliability when creating content. This release addresses several issues with saving snapshots and VR captures.
[/list] 

Please help us to improve Holoswitch and report any issues that you find in our issue tracker: https://bitbucket.org/tripleacode/holoswitchvr/issues/  or share your ideas and feedback in Discord https://discord.gg/B7YPtEu

notes.title: [Update] Pop-up Peephole
notes.content:
Hey guys, 
today's update brings the pop-up Peelhole! It will additionally show the Peephole as an overlay directly in your view. Now you can see the Peephole without using your VR controllers.

To activate/deactivate it just open the Holoswitch via SteamVR's dashboard and go to the Peephole tab.

You can also adjust the position, size, and switch between the front and back camera.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36521959/6da641ca42f54596297ea4ea5eb748bd0e4a427e.png[/img]

We also fixed some minor issues and bugs.
If you have any questions feel free to join us on Discord [url=https://discord.gg/B7YPtEu]here[/url].

Stay healthy guys!

Richard from Holoswitch

notes.title: [Update] Tutorial "skipping" for users without VR controllers
notes.content:
Hey guys,

a new small update because we've heard that a lot of you are playing games without VR controllers and can't complete the tutorial.

From now on the tutorial will only appear when [u]two controllers are connected[/u]. 

You're welcome!

notes.title: [Update] Video Recording Quality Settings
notes.content:
Hey guys, small and quick [b]Update:[/b]

You can now select the video recording quality in the settings. There's a huuuuuuuuge [b]increase of the video quality[/b] (and of course of the file size) possible now so we made you guys be able to [b]choose your preferred quality[/b] now!

You're welcome!

tags.feature: You can now select the video recording quality in the settings.

notes.title: [Update] Video & Image Viewer, Holocom Interaction
notes.content:
Hey guys,

here's a new update:

We added a [b]video & image viewer[/b] to the VR [b]Gallery[/b] of Holoswitch. Means you can now have a closer look at your captures directly from within VR! And yes: Asap you'll be able to choose the storage location with the upcoming update!! It's on our list :)

We also adjusted the Holocom interaction system. You can now interact (e.g. starting the Recorder) by simply touching it. It gets activated automatically. No need to perform the activation gesture anymore.

Besides that, we also did some smaller fixes and adjustments e.g. adding a small Peephole indicator that's appearing when the Peephole is active.

As always if you have any questions or issues please send us a mail or message here or on our Discord. We're constantly fixing bugs and improving the app. 

Cheers
Richard from Holoswitch :)

notes.title: [BETA TEST] Peephole
notes.content:
Hi guys! We’re very happy and proud to start this new year with a new feature in BETA: Peephole.

Being in VR isolates us from the real world. To always know what’s happening around you we’ve created a feature called „Peephole“. It streams your smartphone camera directly to VR. 
Position your phone anywhere in the room and watch your personal live stream as an overlay on top of your VR experiences.

So today we would like to invite you to test Peephole on the beta branch and provide us with some feedback.

To switch to the Holoswitch beta branch in Steam

[list]
[*] Update the Holoswitch mobile app
[*] Make sure Holoswitch is not running + also make sure that Holobridge (tray icon) is not running
[*] Right-click on Holoswitch > properties
[*] Select the beta tab and then select the beta in the dropdown.
[/list]

We highly appreciate your feedback on Discord: https://discord.gg/B7YPtEu to create the best experiences possible!

You're welcome!

notes.title: Update: Snapshots and Holocom
notes.content:
We’re proud to announce that there’s a new update: Snapshots and Holocom!
You’re now able to create quick screenshots. Simply press SteamVR’s screenshot shortcut to trigger a snapshot. You’ll hear a typical camera shutter sound and see a short preview of your shot. After that, the image gets forwarded directly to your Windows picture folder and gets synchronized with our new Gallery in the Holoswitch mobile app. From there you can easily post it on Social Media or share it with friends.

Holocom also passed the beta test and is now available in this new version.
Holocom acts like a virtual smartwatch and will become the primary way of interacting with Holoswitch in VR. You will now receive a gentle haptic feedback and sound on your controller. When you look at your wrist you will see the last notification that came.

Additionally, you have the possibility to set pop-up notifications and to set the Holocom to "always-on" on "auto". You can decide for yourself if you want to see the Holocom all the time or if it should only appear when you look at it. 
We also improved the UI and stability of Holoswitch. 

[b]Here's how to use your Holocom:[/b]
[previewyoutube=0GsrcL5jYjk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]And here's how to create snapshots with Holoswitch:[/b]
[previewyoutube=6l0NDbqiFNw;full][/previewyoutube]

Please also update our mobile app. It’s mandatory to use the new features!


We highly appreciate your feedback on Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/B7YPtEu]Holoswitch Discord[/url] to create the best experiences possible! We created a new #voting channel where you can quickly vote for new features and give feedback.

Cheers,
your Holoswitch Team

notes.title: [BETA TEST] UX/UI Update VR: Holocom
notes.content:
Hi guys! We have been quiet for some time but rest assured that we spent the time on exciting new features and improving stability. 
We heard your feedback that often notification overlays are in the way and interfering with the game that you are playing. One month ago we went back to the drawing board and came up with Holocom, which acts as a virtual smartwatch and will become the primary way of interacting with Holoswitch in VR. So now instead of having Notifications pop up in front of your view, you will receive a gentle haptic feedback and sound on your controller. 
And when you look at your wrist you will see the last notification that came in.
So today we would like to invite you to test Holocom on the beta branch and provide us with some feedback.

To switch to the Holoswitch beta branch in Steam

[list]
    [*]make sure Holoswitch is [u]not running[/u] + also make sure that Holobridge (tray icon) is [u]not running[/u]
    [*]right-click on Holoswitch > properties
    [*]select the beta tab and then select the beta in the dropdown.
[/list]

We highly appreciate your feedback on Discord: https://discord.gg/B7YPtEu to create the best experiences possible!

You're welcome!
